visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long black hair, wearing a white long-sleeved top and a pearl necklace, stands on a street at night. She points her finger and smiles at the camera while street food stalls and people are visible in the background. (2) The camera cuts to a close-up of the woman's face as she leans in very close to the lens with an exaggerated expression. (3) She is seen walking through a brightly lit night market with various colorful goods hanging in stalls. She drops a small purple wallet onto the dark asphalt ground. (4) The setting shifts to a wide grassy field at night. A prominent white lighthouse stands in the background. The woman sits on the grass, gesturing towards the lighthouse, while other visitors are seen sitting nearby. (5) A white telescope is positioned on the field with a yellow sign attached to its side. The woman is then seen bending over to look through a large white telescope in the dark field. (6) The camera captures a screen recording of a smartphone application showing a dark blue interface with star constellations and technical UI elements. (7) At night, two men are performing live music on a stage set up in front of the lighthouse. One man plays a guitar while the other sings into a microphone. (8) The camera pans across a large crowd of people sitting on the grass, holding up their smartphones with flashlights on, creating a sea of lights under the night sky.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to promote a stargazing event called 'Embrace the Universe in Hengchun' in celebration of the 150th anniversary of Hengchun's founding. It highlights the availability of telescopes and a specific star-tracking app to attract tourists to Kenting.
